description: Process all due memorization reviews. Called by scheduler to reinforce memories via spaced repetition.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Results of processing due memorization reviews with counts of processed and completed items
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Processing due spaced repetition reviews in the memorization queue
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: DatabaseError: failed to query or update memorization records. StrengthUpdateError: failed to update memory strength values.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For database errors: verify state storage is accessible. For strength update errors: verify the memory records exist.
